name: TED Masterclass
what_it_is: TED's official 11-lesson public speaking course app hosted by Chris Anderson, with animated lessons and talk development steps.
notes: Lesson list public; exercise = build your own talk.

name: Ovation VR
what_it_is: VR/desktop public speaking simulator with AI audiences, venues, interruptions, and AI-generated feedback.
notes: Simulation parameters (audience mood, Q&A) = exercise design ideas.

name: LikeSo
what_it_is: 'Personal speech fitness' app: talk against prompts ('TalkAbout' game) and get scored on filler words and pace.
notes: Game modes (e.g., topic roulette) relevant to drill design.

name: Charisma Virtual Social Coaching (Center for BrainHealth, UT Dallas)
what_it_is: Clinician-guided virtual-world social coaching where users practice conversations in simulated scenarios.
notes: Evidence-based social practice design; research papers describe exercise protocol.
